name: Terraform MCP Server
outcome_statement: As of 2026-11-14: meets C1, C2, C3, C4, C5, C6, C7, C8, C10; partly meets C9.

findings.title: Source and release provenance
findings.finding: The source repository is public. The publisher's release site lists version 1.4.1 with a checksums file and signature files (`terraform-mcp-server_1.4.1_SHA256SUMS.sig`).

findings.title: Published security policy
findings.finding: GitHub shows a security policy for the repository, and it describes how to report a vulnerability.

findings.title: Maintenance status
findings.finding: The repository is not archived and the package is not marked deprecated. Latest release v1.4.1 is dated 2026-10-23; the newest commit on `main` is dated 2026-11-11; GitHub reports the last push on 2026-11-13.

findings.title: Published advisories
findings.finding: No advisory is published in the repository's advisory list.

findings.title: Documented scope controls
findings.finding: Tools that require explicit approval are documented as off by default; toolset and tool selection are documented. Quoted: “`ENABLE_TF_OPERATIONS` | Enable tools that require explicit approval | `false` |”.

findings.title: Credential handling in the documented setup
findings.finding: The API token is supplied through an environment variable. Quoted: “`TFE_TOKEN` | Terraform Enterprise API token”.

findings.title: Telemetry and outbound data, as documented
findings.finding: The README describes OpenTelemetry metrics as a feature the operator enables; no collection by the publisher is described. Quoted: “Integration with open telemetry meters to track tool-call volume, latency and failures in Streamable HTTP mode.”.

findings.title: Dependency management files
findings.finding: A lockfile (`go.sum`) and an update configuration (`.github/dependabot.yml`) are committed.

findings.title: Documentation of untrusted-content risk
findings.finding: The README carries a security note about untrusted clients and models; it does not name prompt injection or untrusted content returned by tools. Quoted: “Do not use the MCP server with untrusted MCP clients or LLMs.”.

findings.title: Currency of the declared MCP library
findings.finding: Declared MCP library: go-sdk v1.8.0 (and mark3labs/mcp-go v0.58.0) in go.mod. Lower-bound version v1.8.0 of github.com/modelcontextprotocol/go-sdk was published on 2026-09-04, within the 12 months before 2026-11-14.
